description: Defines the data structures and functions for managing arrays of object identifiers, including appending, lookup, sorting, filtering, and iteration over unique elements.

methods.name: oid_array_append
methods.description: Adds an object ID to the array, potentially losing order.

methods.name: oid_array_lookup
methods.description: Performs binary search for an object ID; sorts array if not sorted.

methods.name: oid_array_clear
methods.description: Frees memory and resets the array to empty.

methods.name: oid_array_for_each
methods.description: Iterates over each object ID, executing a callback.

methods.name: oid_array_for_each_unique
methods.description: Iterates over unique object IDs in sorted order, sorting if necessary.

methods.name: oid_array_filter
methods.description: Filters the array based on a callback function.

methods.name: oid_array_sort
methods.description: Sorts the array in ascending order of object IDs.

methods.name: oid_array_next_unique
methods.description: Returns the index of the next unique object ID after a given position.
